setup: A rotation is signed, with anticlockwise positive, and this instance gives [[k]] degrees.

steps.say: A clockwise turn of [[k]] degrees has signed measure -[[k]], so the sign records the direction and the magnitude stays positive.
Coterminal angles differ by whole turns of 360 degrees, so adding one turn to a negative measure brings it into [0, 360).
The reduction removes the largest whole number of turns that fits and adds one turn back when the remainder is negative.
